title: Extract fieldwork::relationship_db — composite relationship queries
description: Promote common relationship building from db_extras.rs into fieldwork. Composes: follows_db::is_following_remote + followers_db::is_following + interactions_db::is_blocked + is_muted + follows show_reblogs/notify fields. Returns a Relationship struct matching Mastodon API shape. Used by every follow/unfollow/block/mute endpoint.
